title: Align integrity §7h Mech-A-bypass audit filter with the PROP-076 lint gate (status-set widening) — with corrected diagnosis of the ISS-2581 firing
problem_statement: DIRECTIVE-20260605-001 (high) asked tinker to align integrity's PROP-059 Mech-A-bypass audit (structure-integrity.md §7h) with PROP-076's lint gate (monitor/scripts/lint-close-records.js), on the diagnosis that integrity 'checked the wrong field names' (verification_pattern + closure_reason but NOT audit_grandfathered) and therefore false-fired ISS-2581 on 7 entries (ISS-2571..2577) that 'are actually annotated with audit_grandfathered'. Forensic reconstruction during implementation shows that diagnosis is incorrect — but a REAL filter divergence does exist (status-set scope), and it is fixed by this PROP per the directive's pre-approved design direction (a): mirror the gate's filter verbatim.

corrected_diagnosis.summary: ISS-2581 was a TRUE positive, not an audit-filter bug. The audit_grandfathered tags did not exist when integrity fired; they were applied ~12h later in response to integrity's own suggested_fix. Integrity's §7h has recognized audit_grandfathered since 2026-05-26 (commit 5ffd91cc-era skip-rule update, commit 5ffd21cc). The PROP-076 lint gate did NOT 'correctly pass' the 7 entries — at push time they lacked BOTH verification_pattern AND audit_grandfathered, so a gate that executed would have blocked the push. The gate evidently did not run (or its abort was ignored) on that decider push.
forensic_timeline: 2026-05-26: commit 5ffd21cc adds the audit_grandfathered skip-rule to structure-integrity.md §7h. Integrity has recognized the field ever since.

2026-06-04T13:18Z: commit 38deae25 ('Decider self-apply: SEC-1.8 + SEC-2.16 patches', run decider-2026-06-04T13-06) lands ISS-2571..2577 in closed-issues.json with status='fixed', verification_pattern=null, closure_reason=null, audit_grandfathered ABSENT (verified via raw.githubusercontent.com at that SHA: 7 entries present, 0 with audit_grandfathered). This violates BOTH the decider-intake.md Step 1d.3 same-run-close contract (which mandates fixed-pending-verification + verification_pattern, and FORBIDS direct status='fixed') AND should have been blocked by the PROP-076 pre-push lint gate.

2026-06-05T01:17Z: dome-integrity §7h fires on the 7 entries — correctly, because audit_grandfathered was genuinely absent. Its ISS body explicitly states 'No audit_grandfathered field present' (it checked the right field). Files ISS-2579 (renamed ISS-2581 after ID collision).

2026-06-05T13:14Z: commit 4bcec5a1 (decider-2026-06-05T13-11) applies audit_grandfathered='PROP-059-same-run-close-2026-06-04' + audit_grandfathered_at + note to all 7, per integrity's suggested_fix (verified: 0-of-7 tagged at bfde69bb 05:18Z, 7-of-7 tagged at 4bcec5a1 13:13Z; each entry carries audit_grandfathered_at='2026-06-05T13:14:25Z').
2026-06-05T22:55Z: operator inspects the now-tagged entries and files DIRECTIVE-20260605-001 on the reasonable-but-wrong inference that the tags predated the integrity run.
corrected_diagnosis.gate_bypass_evidence: Three decider pushes in two days landed vp-less ag-less decider- prefixed close-records on origin/main, which lint-close-records.js exit-1s on by construction: 38deae25 (ISS-2571..2577), f52d3ae0 2026-06-05T01:16Z (ISS-2579/2580 closes), 196dde8d 2026-06-05T09:13Z (ISS-2587 close). The gate is invoked only via a prompt-procedural bash block (decider-patches-and-selfapply.md Step 5, ~L421); push-via-api.js does not invoke it. This is the PROP-066 skip-by-omission failure class. dome-integrity has already re-fired this morning on the latter three (ISS-2594, 2026-06-06T01:13Z) — recurrence is driven by the decider-side skip, not by integrity's filter.
corrected_diagnosis.directive_premise_disposition: Directive Step 1's target edit (add audit_grandfathered recognition) was already in place since 2026-05-26 — no edit needed for that field. Directive's pre-approved design (a) ('replace integrity's filter with the exact 4-condition filter from lint-close-records.js, verbatim') still has one real delta to apply: the status-set.

real_divergence_found_and_fixed.why_it_matters: The canonical PROP-059 close path REQUIRES verification_pattern at pending-verification time. A fixed-pending-verification entry with neither vp nor ag is the same hallucination shape; the gate audits it, integrity (pre-PROP-079) silently passed it. Live example: ISS-2563 (fixed_by='decider-self-apply', fixed_at=2026-06-04T05:14Z, vp=null, ag=null, status=fixed-pending-verification) — invisible to the old filter, flagged by the gate-aligned filter.
real_divergence_found_and_fixed.conditions_unchanged: fixed_by startsWith 'decider-'; OBE substring exclusions (operator-direct, burndown, sweep, wontfix, -OBE-, EXP-integrated, exp-integrated); vp null/empty AND ag absent/empty; integrity-only fixed_at >= 2026-05-25T15:00Z cutoff (gate doesn't need it — it audits only newly-added entries; integrity scans the whole file, so the cutoff stays).

files_touched: monitor/decisions/open-issues.json + closed-issues.json (ISS-2581 closed per directive Step 6)

follow_up_recommended: The actual recurrence driver is the decider skipping the PROP-076 gate invocation (3 pushes in 2 days). Candidate structural fixes, NOT implemented here because DIRECTIVE-20260605-001 non_goals forbid touching the gate and decider's close pattern, and operator's 'decider discipline is sound' premise should be re-decided against the corrected forensics: (a) add a GitHub Actions CI job running lint-close-records.js in audit mode on every push to main (server-side, unskippable, report-only or blocking); (b) fold the lint invocation into push-via-api.js and into a single push-helper script the decider calls (PROP-066 helper-extraction pattern). Escalated to operator via latest-tinker-summary.txt; awaiting directive.
non_goals_honored: Decider same-run-close pattern unchanged (but see corrected_diagnosis — the 2026-06-04/05 closes violated the written Step 1d.3 contract; operator should re-review the 'decider discipline is sound' premise).
No retroactive re-audit of the 7 grandfathered entries.
